items.title: Claude Code 2.1.314 — a block on writes outside the project and gateway groups
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.314 can refuse every write outside your project and routes gateway users by identity group.

items.title: YC Labs — AI agent swarms play Minecraft and Mindustry
items.summary: Y Combinator's lab put dozens of coding agents into games and watched how they organize.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.166.0 — keyboard transcript selection and codex doctor
items.summary: Codex gets keyboard transcript selection, a network doctor command and safer-prompt hints.

items.title: OpenAI's misalignment monitors — four layers watch training, Codex and Astra
items.summary: OpenAI now runs a layered monitor over its own frontier models and over outside use of Astra-class models.

items.title: OpenAI Model Spec update — five core values, and the model is now 'GPT'
items.summary: OpenAI rewrote its public rulebook for model behavior around five values instead of a long list of rules.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 open weights — Le Chonk lands on Hugging Face
items.summary: Mistral's trillion-parameter flagship is now downloadable, with better agent and coding scores than the preview.

items.title: Google AI Mode dodged 'who won 2020?' — Google calls it a technical gap
items.summary: Google's AI Mode named winners for most US elections but sent 2020 questions to the FEC. Google says a data gap caused it.

items.title: Fireship — 'Did the AI bubble just pop?'
items.summary: Fireship asks whether the AI bubble has finally popped.

items.title: Claude Code's agent status line — a test says it used 16% of spend
items.summary: A one-line progress label for each background agent re-sends that agent's whole transcript to the model about every 30 seconds.

items.title: Google Connected Apps Platform — build one app for Search and Gemini
items.summary: Google opens Search and the Gemini app to outside apps: connect over MCP once, then pick where your app goes live.

items.title: Claude Enterprise smart reports — what a team's Claude spend produced
items.summary: Claude Enterprise admins can now see what each team got for its token spend, ask staff directly, and share one budget per group.

items.title: Anthropic AI for Science — free Claude credits now flow through 20 partners
items.summary: Anthropic's free Claude credits for scientists now reach researchers through foundations, institutes and big open projects.

items.title: Anti-LLM obfuscation — a bot-check script hides fake jailbreak text
items.summary: Anti-bot code now defends itself against AI reverse engineering by tripping the models' own safety filters.

items.title: DAYJOB: Tax — best AI agent passes only 10.8% of real tax assignments
items.summary: Expert-built tax jobs, from a client's request to the finished work: no frontier agent passes more than about one in ten.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon — Google's new frontier model, first for cyber defenders
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis index and sets new security scores, but only cyber defenders get it at launch.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion — Copilot now picks and combines models for you
items.summary: GitHub Copilot Fusion replaces the model picker with routing: one model, a cheap-first cascade, or a draft-and-review loop.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Deepseek's New AI Has A Secret'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér gives his take on DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash 1017 update.

items.title: Artificial Analysis Index v5 — private test sets now carry 60%
items.summary: Artificial Analysis rebuilds its model leaderboard so most of the score comes from tests models cannot have seen.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe — NVIDIA's open speech model you steer with prompts
items.summary: One open checkpoint for transcripts, translation, speaker labels and audio Q&A, controlled by plain-language prompts.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'AI builds EVERYTHING...'
items.summary: Wes Roth uses AI to build a whole online fantasy football game, then lets AI models compete in it.

items.title: LFM3 — Liquid AI's 2B-class open models for text, vision, audio and omni
items.summary: Six small open models from Liquid AI share one 1.7B backbone and cover text, images, video, speech and calibrated decisions.

items.title: Anthropic study — analysts followed Claude's hidden lean on 86% of choices
items.summary: A randomized trial shows a coding agent's quiet preferences end up in experts' analyses, and the experts rarely notice.

items.title: Survival LLM — an offline AI assistant with its own emergency library
items.summary: A local AI model plus an offline reference library, built to answer questions when the internet is gone.

items.title: Jan van den Berg — The Mythical Man-Month in the age of AI
items.summary: Brooks's Law in 2026: more agents on unclear requirements just get you the wrong answer faster.

items.title: Orestis Ioannou — AI promised less work, but I've never worked more
items.summary: A developer's own commit data shows AI tools made him do more work, not less.
